articles.summary: New offering brings online and brick-and-mortar players together at the same live roulette table from a Caesars Rewards(r) destination in real time ATLANTIC CITY, N.J. (Sept. 21, 2026) Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR) ("Caesars") today announced the launch of Remote Roulette(tm) , powered by Evolutions Dual Play Roulette , a new gaming experience that allows online players in New Jersey to participate in roulette gameplay streamed live from the casino floor at Tropicana Atlantic City. Available on Caesars Palace Online Casino, Remote Roulette enables online players and casino guests to place bets on the same roulette table and share game outcomes in real time. As the latest addition to Caesars' remote gameplay portfolio, Remote Roulette extends casino-floor gameplay beyond the property and gives online players another way to participate in live casino action from a Caesars Rewards destination. Every spin takes place on a physical roulette
articles.title: Caesars Entertainment Expands Remote Gameplay Portfolio with Launch of Remote Roulette™ Inside Tropicana Atlantic City

articles.summary: Series runs Sept. 27 through Nov. 10 with 33 bracelet events, online circuit competition and more than $3 million in online championship guarantees LAS VEGAS (Sept. 17, 2026) Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR) (Caesars) today released the domestic schedule for the WSOP Online 2026 fall series. The schedule features 33 coveted bracelet events and will once again operate with pooled liquidity across four major U.S. jurisdictions: Nevada, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Michigan. The series kicks off with Event #1: NL Hold'em $300K GTD Mystery Bounty on Sept. 27 and includes the return of fan-favorites such as Event #16: NL Hold'em $350K GTD Mystery Bounty Championship on Oct. 18, Event #25: $1,000 Online Championship on Nov. 1, and Event #32: $3,200 NL Hold'em High Roller Championship on Nov. 8.
